text:
maria: FYI repro while onboarding hf/gpt-mini-rlhf-8bit -> redwood runtime. Streaming output stops right after KV cache restore on step 1 of many. Looks like we get an EOS token emitted twice and runtime treats it as final. Repro steps below.

sahil: can you paste the minimal repro? :eyes:

maria: sure
```
# convert
python convert.py --model hf/gpt-mini-rlhf --to redwood --quantize 8bit --chat-template chat_v1
# run
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Tell a short joke","stream":true,"stop":["\n",""],"max_new_tokens":50}' https://api.redwood.dev/generate
```

maria: logs:
```
[serve] kvcache restore done
[decode] token=50256 ("")
[decode] token=50256 ("")  <-- double
[stream] finalize_stream: reason=stop_token
```
jin: hmm double 50256 suggests tokenizer mapping produced duplicate stop entries. Did convert script map both '' and '<|endoftext|>'? :thinking_face:

maria: convert.json had chat stop seq set from HF chat template -> ["", "<|endoftext|>"] which later normalized to two identical internal ids after byte-pair merge.

sahil: could be caused by tokenizer.add_special_tokens or legacy aliasing during tokenization. Can you gdb the tokenizer ids? Also which tokenizer version?

maria: hf/transformers 4.36.1, tokenizers 0.15.2. Dumped tokenizer.encode(""), both produced 50256.

qa: I ran the quantized run with logging on, and observed stream emits partial tokens then EOF after kv restore on ~seq len 8. Looks like early termination triggered by seeing EOS twice in buffer flush.

ops-bot: Deploy alert: rolling back canary model gpt-mini-rlhf-quant from prod-canary-3

jin: quick workaround: drop duplicate stop tokens when building runtime stopset. I can push a patch to normalization logic to dedupe by token id and canonicalize empty string to single id.

maria: repro confirms patch fixes it locally. Also added a check in conversion to collapse identical stop sequences in config.json.

sahil: add a unit test for streaming + kvcache restore + duplicate-stop case. Also add a note for model-onboarding checklist about tokenizers: check special token aliasing and roundtrip encode/decode of stop tokens.

maria: filed ticket: ML-1234, attaching conversion snippet and failing logs. thanks :thumbsup:

qa: will run regression tests across quant levels (8bit/4bit/naive) tomorrow.

maria: merging patch after tests pass. Thanks everyone.
